org.souther-lang:souther-program-api-test 0.1.0 发布, Stands where an output outside souther-compiler stands. It depends on souther-compiler and on
        nothing else of this project, reads a checked program through the boundary meant for it, and
        holds that boundary to what it is for: a compiler is not something an output reads.

        Nothing ships from here. It exists because the property being kept — that an artifact of its
        own can consume a checked Souther program — is about what a separate artifact can compile
        against, and no test living inside souther-compiler is separate from it.

    possible values. There are two reasons to use Ruler: 1/ It's fast; the time it takes to match Events doesn't
    depend on the number of Rules. 2/ Customers like the JSON "query language" for expressing rules.
